changes.zh: 语文模块新增基于 `hanzibox` 的 `\compositiongrid` 中文作文格命令：必选参数指定最少作文格数并自动向上补齐整行，支持按当前页剩余空间自动分页、在 600 等累计字数处显示提示，并可设置每行格数、按当前字号缩放或直接指定格子大小、行距比例、格型、颜色和线宽；同时补充真实跨页示例与手册说明。
changes.en: Added a `hanzibox`-based `\compositiongrid` command to the Chinese module. Its mandatory argument requests a minimum cell count rounded up to a complete row; it also supports automatic page splitting, cumulative character-count markers, font-relative or explicit cell sizing, configurable grid styling, and a realistic multi-page example.
